name: Find out why a witness never reached the board

uses.action: Follow the covered stall’s undelivered notice, then unfasten the flap used to discard west witnesses before reading them. Replay both sightlines as separate checks.

name: Keep a first perception separate from the later account

uses.action: Watch the first cart pass and pin its observed detail. Hear Edrin’s later account, replay the two views and lift the saved first sketch before revising the handover.
